resources.string: Maps the Home button to open Balooga instead of the default launcher.
Choose where focus returns after leaving an application.
Returns to the app you last selected.
Always starts on the first app in Favorites.
Always starts on the Home tab.
Always starts on the All Apps tab.
Restores the last tab you used. Focused item and scroll position are coming soon.
Learn the essential remote actions and how focus behaves in this launcher.
Use the direction buttons to move focus. Moving focus does not open an item. Press the center button only when you want to activate the focused item.
Long-press the center button on an app card to open its options. Press Back to close the options and return to that app card.
Use Back to recover your place
Back closes a popup or settings page first. When a previous control is still available, focus returns to it. The Home button continues to use your system launcher settings.
Open system app settings to disable or enable the Google TV launcher.
Enabled and it owns the Home key

This launcher lost the Home key and the system settings page cannot disable the Google TV launcher again. Connect the device to adb and run: adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 com.google.android.apps.tv.launcherx.
Press DOWN repeatedly to find Balooga. Press Center to enable. After enabling, if Home still opens Google TV Launcher, return here and enable the Home button remap service below.
Open the last app you were using.
Apps you have hidden from the All Apps grid. Hidden apps are still installed.
Home tab. Continue, Recent, Favorites, Watch Next.

Choose your preferred language for apps on this device. This opens the system language settings.

Configure screen reader, TalkBack, high-contrast text, switch access, and other accessibility services.
On — audio descriptions are enabled for media playback.
Off — audio descriptions are not enabled.
Audio descriptions narrate on-screen action during media playback for users who cannot see the screen.
Increases text contrast for better visibility.

This launcher is designed for accessibility. Press D-pad to move focus. Press Center to activate. Long-press Center on any app to open options. Press Back to go back and recover your previous position.
Enable this service so the Home button opens Balooga instead of Google TV Launcher. Turn TalkBack off first in Settings.
